discussion_comments.comment_body:
On the BC: double-checked and it's not an intended breaking change. The 2025-07-01 spec declares rules.items as plain int32 with no x-nullable; the released SDK baseline and the PS layer both use non-nullable int (List<int>). The IList<int?> is purely an @autorest/powershell 4.x default (it makes primitive array elements nullable), so x-nullable=false restores the released contract rather than hiding a real BC.

On regeneration: agreed — I'll regenerate the SDK from the updated README so the change is produced by the directive rather than a manual edit, and confirm the only resulting delta is Rules reverting to IList<int>. Will push the regenerated output.
